verdict.rationale: Framer's AI agent can restructure and suggest layout changes based on generic 'conversion best practices' (framer-docs-31/38) and manages/organizes CMS data (framer-docs-8/46), which is adjacent to data-driven suggestions, but there is no evidence of the agent analyzing a user's actual site/traffic data to surface analytical insights (e.g., performance, SEO, or visitor-behavior insights) — it is generative/design assistance rather than data-insight generation. Missing for 10: evidence of analytics-based insight generation, data pattern analysis, or dashboards summarizing user's own data trends.
